ahoyboihart: Rafael "Shadow" Ahoyboihart stepped off the supply cart at V-F3 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
A parcel from home held a comb. Rafael "Shadow" Ahoyboihart has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
The promotion to Lance Corporal reached Rafael "Shadow" Ahoyboihart on a creased slip of paper. He smoothed it and put it with the letters from home.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Rafael "Shadow" Ahoyboihart put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.

Rafael "Shadow" Ahoyboihart threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Matthias "Shadow" Yahyahbouy was down and screaming for a medic. (@yahyahbouy) Rafael "Shadow" Ahoyboihart came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Rafael "Shadow" Ahoyboihart died waiting. The men at V-F3 have not stopped talking about it.
The House of Ahoyboihart sent Arno Ahoyboihart after Rafael "Shadow" Ahoyboihart. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Arno Ahoyboihart of the Concord left a loaf of bread on a post at the Bone Quarry, with a note: 'for whoever is hungry'. Quentin "Hollow" Titlefightlo took the bread and left a tin of beef.
carlingiti: They issued Otto Carlingiti a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a bullet that missed him in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
Otto Carlingiti was in the first hundred. The old hands in S-F12 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.

An empty jam tin became Otto Carlingiti's cup. The first drink tasted faintly of strawberries. He took smaller sips than usual. Verdel Ridge is lost. Otto Carlingiti heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Otto Carlingiti and Zeno Ramsey split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.

Otto Carlingiti kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it. The new duty roster listed Otto Carlingiti as a machine gunner. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

A shell splinter the size of a fist hit Otto Carlingiti at S-F12. He is alive and he is in pain, and he needs a bed. Outside the aid post, Otto Carlingiti lies on a stretcher among the others. The orderlies step over him and say soon. A letter from home found Otto Carlingiti before the night shift. Otto Carlingiti folded it small and kept it close. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Otto Carlingiti watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

The bearers moved Otto Carlingiti's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule. A letter from home found Otto Carlingiti before the night shift. Otto Carlingiti folded it small and kept it close.
There was never a bed for Otto Carlingiti, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F12 on his own feet.

Two men fed the belt while Otto Carlingiti held the gun steady on the enemy parapet. When they stopped, Albin Zgz was grazed. A bullet hit Otto Carlingiti in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at S-F12. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Lucien Raphoto of the Concord (@r.raphoto). A letter from home found Otto Carlingiti before the night shift. Otto Carlingiti folded it small and kept it close.
Otto Carlingiti spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped.

Otto Carlingiti healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving. The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Otto Carlingiti did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again. A letter from home found Otto Carlingiti before the night shift. Otto Carlingiti folded it small and kept it close.

The gun at S-F12 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Matthias Covonarson, grazed. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Otto Carlingiti could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Otto Carlingiti smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Karel "Brick" Jarnvag came out for a cup and was badly wounded. Two shots, one miss. The second found Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich, grazed. Otto Carlingiti cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. A letter from home found Otto Carlingiti before the night shift. Otto Carlingiti folded it small and kept it close. Otto Carlingiti asked to leave the machine gunners and serve as a stretcher bearer. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.

Otto Carlingiti brought back a wounded man and a lost machine gun from the Hanging Bridge in one trip. He is Lance Corporal now. A letter from home found Otto Carlingiti before the night shift. Otto Carlingiti folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet went through Otto Carlingiti's upper arm at S-F12 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out.

Otto Carlingiti finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept. A letter from home found Otto Carlingiti before the night shift. Otto Carlingiti folded it small and kept it close.
A surgeon stopped at Otto Carlingiti's bed, checked the dressing and moved on without a word. He decided that was good news.

No bed, no surgeon, just a medic with a kit and a lot of patience. Otto Carlingiti recovered anyway and is back at S-F12. The letter for Otto Carlingiti had been in the rain somewhere along the way. Otto Carlingiti dried it by the stove, page by page.

A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Emil Hartilllondo's name scratched on it. Otto kicked it back. It did not come again. The mail wagon was late, but there was a letter for Otto. Otto read it with a cold biscuit in one hand.
j._.inspace: They issued Quentin Inspace a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a cracked shaving mirror in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Rumour reached P-F15 that the war would be over by spring. Quentin Inspace has heard it before. So has everyone. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Quentin Inspace watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Quentin Inspace tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
Quentin Inspace found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a wedding party, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.
Quentin Inspace keeps the photograph in his pocket next to a cracked shaving mirror. He says he will give it back after the war. Nobody asks to whom.
Quentin Inspace left the photograph on a stake in the wire at Sorrow Copse, wrapped in oilcloth. In the morning it was gone. In its place: a single cigarette.
Henrik "Mud" Monkey and Quentin Inspace carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Quentin Inspace added a leak above the man's head in pencil.
Dietrich "Spark" Geddy (Hegemony) and Quentin Inspace (Concord) were sent out to cut the other side's wire at the Bone Quarry on the same night. They met in the middle and agreed to go home.
kaba.b00m: On Day 17 Zeno Kaba took a post at V-F2 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He hums hymns when frightened, and the men liked him for it.
A bullet hit the sandbag next to Zeno's ear at V-F2 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Otto Helton of the Concord (@josh.helton0301).
mister_funni_man: Day 9: Nils Man reached R-C2 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Nils Man had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Valentin "Smokes" Lilmaggs was badly wounded. News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-C2 with the rations. Nils Man ate while listening to the revised orders.

Nils Man drew a map of Severin "Hollow" Linktheduck's hometown from Hollow's stories. Hollow says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Nils Man is number 776. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Nils Man wrote to an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
A bullet grazed Nils Man's ribs at R-C2. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Nils Lettersupona of the Hegemony (@lettersuponashes).
Nils Man's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-C2 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
Oskar Dreams of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Nils Man kept the tin.

Nils Man fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-C2. Tobias Gorilla was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Nils Man shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Anselm Hohlmike, was grazed.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Nils Man fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.
Nils Man was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.
Nils smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Nils Lettersupona came out for a cup and was grazed.
nicola.bachini: The draft reached R-R9 on Day 9. Teodor Bachini was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

A round came through the loophole Teodor Bachini was watching at R-R9 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Hugo Blasian of the Hegemony (@blasian117). Teodor Bachini was killed at R-R9 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Hugo Blasian of the Hegemony (@blasian117).
The House of Bachini sent Karel Bachini after Teodor Bachini. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-R9 and grazed Karel Bachini's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Henrik Sergiootd of the Hegemony (@sergiootd). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Karel Bachini is number 792. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. After the loss of Grey Mill, Karel Bachini helped stack spare sandbags at R-R9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A bullet struck Karel Bachini below the ribs at R-R9. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Emil "Button" Mugginsthede of the Hegemony (@mugginsthedestroyer).
For days Karel Bachini was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle.
Behind the lines Karel Bachini had a bath in a beer vat with eleven other men. The water was brown before he got in.
Karel Bachini gave Pavel "Ash" Nugg the last match in the trench. Ash used it to light a candle so that Karel could finish a letter.
A clear shot from R-R9. Karel Bachini badly wounded Marek "Button" Gergely and slid back down below the parapet.
Karel Bachini reached up to fix a sandbag at R-R9 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Jonas Jacob of the Hegemony (@miguell.jacob).
The medic cut the last bandage off Karel's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-R9 the same hour.
nishchay_thegreat: Hugo Thegreat came from Belmonte, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Hugo Thegreat looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Hugo Thegreat and Zeno "Shadow" Mw found a cat in the ruins at Saint-Ash crossroads and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Shadow. Hugo Thegreat got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 747. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In S-C2, Hugo Thegreat listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Hugo Thegreat tested the telephone and heard someone at headquarters chewing. The line was declared perfectly clear.
Hugo Thegreat fixed the strap on Nils Scotti's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Hugo Thegreat flashed a lamp signal to the battery behind the ridge. The answer came back: a single word, misspelled.
Hugo Thegreat was hit in the foot through his boot at S-C2. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Arno Zag of the Hegemony (@grz_zag420).
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Hugo Thegreat died waiting. The men at S-C2 have not stopped talking about it.
Isidor "Rabbit" Thegreat came to the front because his cousin Hugo Thegreat never came home. He carries a bullet that missed him.
Isidor "Rabbit" Thegreat gave Nils Scotti the last match in the trench. Nils used it to light a candle so that Rabbit could finish a letter.
Isidor found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: an old man with a dog, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.
sneakysnakemgs: Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem joined the replacements on Day 10. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem fell asleep on watch. Benedikt Justmusl took over without waking Button, and told the sergeant nothing. A letter from home found Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem before the night shift. Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at U-F13 changed before the cheering ended. Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem shouldered another load.
Frost made each footprint distinct. Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem followed a trail to the missing ration sack and found the quartermaster sitting on it.
New laces made Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.

Wiring party. Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at U-F13, and everyone came back. A letter from home found Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem before the night shift. Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem folded it small and kept it close.
Roland Tmn drew a map of Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem's hometown from Button's stories. Button says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere.

Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem was hit in the forearm at U-F13. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Viktor Blacksmithsb of the Concord (@blacksmithsbenchstudios). Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem got a letter today. The handwriting was shaky, but the news was good. The letter went inside the helmet, for luck.

The medic cut the last bandage off Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to U-F13 the same hour. A letter for Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem came with a pressed flower inside. Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem showed the flower to nobody.
Ivo "Hollow" Dougdouglas (Concord) threw a loaf of bread into the Hegemony trench at Calvary Farm. An hour later a sausage came back with a note from Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem: 'Fair trade.'
stinkyzebraballs: Florian "Mole" Stinkyzebrab took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Florian "Mole" Stinkyzebrab watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

The gas alarm sounded during supper. Florian "Mole" Stinkyzebrab put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear. After the loss of Grey Mill, Florian "Mole" Stinkyzebrab helped stack spare sandbags at Q-F18. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Florian "Mole" Stinkyzebrab opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
Florian "Mole" Stinkyzebrab dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.
A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Florian "Mole" Stinkyzebrab aimed just below it. Norbert "Doc" Chiaroveto was grazed.
Florian "Mole" Stinkyzebrab fired at the enemy dawn watch from Q-F18. Dietrich Fred was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Florian "Mole" Stinkyzebrab hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
Florian "Mole" Stinkyzebrab and Valentin Peebles found a cat in the ruins at Verdel Ridge and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Valentin.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Florian across the shin at Q-F18. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Isidor "Brick" Crab of the Hegemony (@crab.91078893).
temperedshed: The new sapper is Tobias "Whistle" Temperedshed, once a baker from Belmonte. The corporal asked if a baker was any use in a trench. Tobias "Whistle" Temperedshed said he would find out.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Tobias "Whistle" Temperedshed looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Tobias "Whistle" Temperedshed (Concord) threw a loaf of bread into the Hegemony trench at Lantern Hill. An hour later a sausage came back with a note from Quentin Dtbutikof: 'Fair trade.' The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Tobias "Whistle" Temperedshed watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Tobias "Whistle" Temperedshed warmed the ink bottle inside his tunic. The letter began only when the ink agreed to move.
Tobias "Whistle" Temperedshed failed to return from the wire. A search found tracks leading into churned ground and nothing certain beyond it.
Tobias "Whistle" Temperedshed is still missing. The sergeant keeps his name on the roll and calls it out every morning anyway.
Someone at T-F13 saved Tobias "Whistle" Temperedshed's share of the rations. Nobody said why.
Nobody at T-F13 has seen Tobias "Whistle" Temperedshed since the last patrol. His bunk is still made.
Tobias "Whistle" Temperedshed came back to T-F13 after sheltering with another unit. He brought a note confirming the story and a borrowed mug to return.

Tobias was hit through the chest at T-F13. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Valentin "Ghost" Scotty of the Hegemony (@scotty01851). Tobias was killed at T-F13 reaching for a cup of tea. The cup was still warm when they found it.
The House of Temperedshed sent Matthias Temperedshed after Tobias "Whistle" Temperedshed. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
thedeepnotes: Matthias Thedeepnotes, a clockmaker from Old Harrow, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in P-F3. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Jonas Diegohernand and Matthias Thedeepnotes cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Matthias Thedeepnotes wrote to a teacher who said he would amount to nothing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Matthias Thedeepnotes hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
Matthias Thedeepnotes sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour.
An officer heard about the singing and forbade it. Tonight Matthias Thedeepnotes only whistled the first bar. Across the wire, someone whistled the last.
Karel Diegohernand and Matthias Thedeepnotes carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Matthias Thedeepnotes added a leak above the man's head in pencil.
Isidor "Brick" Evanrobinson and Matthias Thedeepnotes carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.
Matthias (Concord) and Teodor "Button" Cbr (Hegemony) ended up in the same shell hole at Grey Mill. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
theverb95: Arno "Parson" Theverb took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

Arno "Parson" Theverb lay behind a dead tree trunk at R-C12 for six hours without moving. One shot at dusk. Norbert "Shadow" Slush was gravely wounded. Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Arno "Parson" Theverb watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Arno "Parson" Theverb had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Jakub Virajvirxgil was badly wounded. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Arno "Parson" Theverb is number 684. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Arno "Parson" Theverb read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Arno "Parson" Theverb (Concord) and Arno "Doc" As (Hegemony) ended up in the same shell hole at Grey Mill. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
Arno "Parson" Theverb noticed a loophole that had been dark for days. He watched it until dusk and wrote down what changed.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Arno "Parson" Theverb received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.
A parcel came for Arno "Parson" Theverb that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: several carefully wrapped biscuits. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.
The parcel's address was smudged. Arno "Parson" Theverb took it to the clerk, who found two possible units and no reason to hurry.
Arno "Parson" Theverb caught a supply driver heading for one of the units and handed the parcel over with a note asking for word when it arrived.
Arno watched a bird land on the enemy parapet and stay a full minute. He had a clear shot and did not take it.
vinelord_: At the depot, Henrik "Mole" Vinelord had practised answering to his name. At V-F15, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Henrik "Mole" Vinelord read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Someone in V-F15 asked Henrik "Mole" Vinelord about Kesselby. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.
Henrik "Mole" Vinelord was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Henrik "Mole" Vinelord shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Norbert Caique, was grazed.
Henrik "Mole" Vinelord caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
A muddy dog crawled into V-F15 through the wire. Henrik "Mole" Vinelord gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Kaiser.

Henrik "Mole" Vinelord was hit hard at Lantern Hill. Two men carried him down the communication trench on a door torn from a ruin. Henrik "Mole" Vinelord spent the night on a stretcher in the trench behind the aid post. Every bed was taken.
For days Henrik was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle.
yoboiwhitecheddar: On the way to V-F9, Matthias Yoboiwhitech tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way. After the loss of Grey Mill, Matthias Yoboiwhitech helped stack spare sandbags at V-F9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
The last of the jam was shared by adding hot water and calling it a drink. Matthias Yoboiwhitech approved the method.

Matthias Yoboiwhitech spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. A letter from home found Matthias Yoboiwhitech before the night shift. Matthias Yoboiwhitech folded it small and kept it close.
Matthias Yoboiwhitech crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at P-F13 holds again.

Matthias Yoboiwhitech polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too. A letter from home found Matthias Yoboiwhitech before the night shift. Matthias Yoboiwhitech folded it small and kept it close.

Matthias Yoboiwhitech went in with a pistol and a trench club. In the Hegemony trench Otto Strawberrrry put up a fight, but not for long. (@strawberrrryfield_) Matthias Yoboiwhitech went over with the raiders and dropped into the Hegemony trench. Roland "Shadow" Fith was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@grif.fith117) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Matthias Yoboiwhitech snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Matthias Yoboiwhitech free.

The wound on Matthias Yoboiwhitech's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter. A letter from home found Matthias Yoboiwhitech before the night shift. Matthias Yoboiwhitech folded it small and kept it close.
Matthias heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot.
